Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_069617.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: autovcoder_069617.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_069617 (
    input               rst,                  // input reset
    input               enableInvKeyControl,
    input      [0:1919] keyExp,               // unsigned 176-byte expanded key
    input      [   2:0] keySize,
    output reg [ 0:127] invNewKey
);  // output key for invRounds

  integer bottom;
  integer bottom128 = 1280;  // bottom limit of bit-range
  integer bottom192 = 1536;
  integer bottom256 = 1792;

  always @(posedge enableInvKeyControl or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
      invNewKey = 128'd0;
      bottom128 = 1280;  // bottom limit of bit-range
      bottom192 = 1536;
      bottom256 = 1792;
    end else begin
      if (keySize == 3'b100) begin
        bottom = bottom256;
      end else if (keySize == 3'b010) begin
        bottom = bottom192;
      end else begin
        bottom = bottom128;
      end

      case (bottom)
        0: invNewKey = keyExp[0:127];
        128: invNewKey = keyExp[128:255];
        256: invNewKey = keyExp[256:383];
        384: invNewKey = keyExp[384:511];
        512: invNewKey = keyExp[512:639];
        640: invNewKey = keyExp[640:767];
        768: invNewKey = keyExp[768:895];
        896: invNewKey = keyExp[896:1023];
        1024: invNewKey = keyExp[1024:1151];
        1152: invNewKey = keyExp[1152:1279];
        1280: invNewKey = keyExp[1280:1407];
        1408: invNewKey = keyExp[1408:1535];
        1536: invNewKey = keyExp[1536:1663];
        1664: invNewKey = keyExp[1664:1791];
        1792: invNewKey = keyExp[1792:1919];
        default: invNewKey = 128'd0;
      endcase

      bottom256 = bottom256 - 128;
      bottom192 = bottom192 - 128;
      bottom128 = bottom128 - 128;
    end
  end

endmodule
